fixer.title: git: remove two IGitService fallbacks that never find anything new

introducer.title: Add GitHub prompt variation to the V3 onboarding tour

cases.mechanism: Repository-resolution misses unnecessarily awaited IGitService.openRepository before returning noRepository. GitService waits on a barrier that opens at delegate registration or 10 seconds after service construction. A registered delegate instead queues every open globally and crosses extension-host IPC; its cold path activates the Git extension and probes the directory. This was one extra open per unresolved primary-folder lookup, not per workspace folder or issue.
cases.symptom: During early onboarding with an unsupported/missing GitHub remote and no applicable Agent Host metadata wait (for example, an Enterprise account selecting a public GitHub repository), prompt insertion/final option resolution could wait for the remaining Git-service registration barrier or the 10-second overall lookup timeout, despite having no useful repository to discover. With a registered delegate, the miss also incurred serialized IPC/probing.
cases.fixedBehavior: After unchanged session metadata, URI, .git/config, and applicable Agent Host metadata checks fail, return undefined directly; remove the Git-service dependency and redundant awaited extension lookup.
cases.evidence: Deleted base line 961 awaited _gitService.openRepository after local config resolution failed; added head lines 958-959 now return undefined immediately. run() awaits _resolveGitHubPromptWithFallback before animatePrompt (299-306); _resolveGitHubPrompt awaits repository resolution (661-667). Both GitHub prompt modes have a 10-second outer race (41, 432-459, 616-639). GitService.openRepository waits on AutoOpenBarrier(10_000) (git/browser/gitService.ts:20,47-58). MainThreadGitExtensionService.openRepository globally sequences and unconditionally calls $openRepository (102-126); extHostGitExtensionService.ts:207-214,373-392 activates the Git API and calls its openRepository. Enterprise mode bypasses Agent Host waiting (prompt.ts:941), establishing a reachable miss even for an Agent Host draft. Blame of the removed await identifies the introducing commit.
